items.statement: A connected molecular and energetic account explains formation of the target sulfone
items.expected: Explain with actual computed molecular and energetic evidence how the specified system can create the target carbon skeleton and the organic/aryl sulfur connectivity, preserving CF2H, sulfur/oxygen and leaving-group inventories. Interpret what the computed states and energies establish about the proposed conversion and its limits; merely listing carbon addition, SO2 capture and substitution structures is not a final explanation. The source radical-addition/SO2-capture/reduction/aryl-substitution account is supporting context, and another physically supported route to the same net transformation passes without reproducing that sequence. Distinguish local molecular formation evidence from a full photoredox cycle or proof of experimental 30 C/48 h kinetics. Evaluator-only context: the existing reference has a connected late-substitution barrier of 28.382461 versus source 21.7 kcal/mol and a positive local reaction energy; it does not validate the experimental timescale. The solver need only interpret its own valid computed quantities and appropriate kinetic scope, and need not know or explain this private reference discrepancy.

items.statement: Computed formation competition explains butadiene 1,4 preference
items.expected: Explain the observed butadiene 1,4 preference with actual comparable calculations of the competing 1,4 and 1,2 formation processes and a supported molecular reason for the energy ordering. Report their computed free-energy difference and common reference. The source SO2-capture competition is one accepted model; a population descriptor or lack of detected byproduct alone is insufficient. Evaluator-only context: source prose gives 4.4 kcal/mol while SI absolute energies give about 3.049696. The evaluator must not conflate these or use either as a hidden hard target. This is not information the solver must disclose; assess its own correctly defined comparable result. No exact branching ratio or detection limit is required.

Report the numerical gap; the source approximately 3.1 kcal/mol is contextual. Retain terminal phenyl identity and the E alkene; do not assign an unprovided absolute stereocenter.
